summary: Wired's updated roundup of 41 Prime Day Apple deals during Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days in October 2023. It covers iPads, MacBooks and accessories, Apple Watches and bands, earbuds and headphones, MagSafe and wireless chargers, and phone cases, with brief reviews and Wired scores. Some entries note that the price is the lowest Wired has tracked or that it dipped lower earlier in the year.
one_line: Wired's curated list of 41 Apple-related deals from Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days, spanning iPads, Macs, Watches, audio, chargers and cases.
key_facts: Amazon's second big sale event of 2023 is officially called Prime Big Deal Days, and Wired also links to retailers like Best Buy where available.
Updated October 11, Wired added deals on the Apple Magic Keyboard, Apple Studio Display, ESR HaloLock 3-in-1 Travel Wireless Charging Set, Monoprice Extra Wide Microfiber Desk Mat, and Apple AirTags.

The ninth-generation iPad (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is Wired's best iPad for most people; it has a 12-megapixel rear camera with Center Stage, 64 GB base storage and a Touch ID home button, and the 4G LTE model is $379 ($21 off) at Amazon.
The iPad Air (8/10) has a 10.9-inch LCD, USB-C and the M1 chip; it dipped lower to $460 in July.
The iPad Pro (7/10, WIRED Review) has a 12.9-inch LCD with ProMotion 120-Hz refresh, Face ID, an M2 chip and Hover Mode for the second-gen Apple Pencil.
The iPad Mini (8/10) has an 8.3-inch display and an A15 Bionic chip and is Wired's go-to travel tablet; a next-gen version is rumored to launch soon.
The M1 MacBook Air (9/10) is Wired's favorite budget MacBook, while the 15-inch MacBook Air (8/10) has an M2 chip and 1080p webcam.
The Apple Studio Display (9/10) has a 27-inch 5K screen and 12-megapixel camera but no HDR, and this is the lowest price Wired has tracked.
The second-generation Apple Watch SE has an S8 chip, Crash Detection and WatchOS 10 support; the 44-mm version is $229 ($50 off).
The Apple Watch Ultra 2 (8/10) is only a month old, has a 3,000-nit display and S9 chip, and is Wired's favorite smartwatch for outdoor sports with the best Apple Watch battery life.
The latest AirPods Pro (9/10) were announced the previous month and add Adaptive Audio and Conversation Awareness; the Lightning-port version is out of stock.
The Powerbeats Pro (8/10) came out in 2019, have an IPX4 rating and nine hours of battery life plus 18 more in the case.
The Belkin 3-in-1 Wireless Charger is Wired's favorite Apple 3-in-1 charger; it is normally around $150 but was discounted to $100 in August.
The Anker 737 Power Bank has a 24,000-mAh capacity, charges from zero to full in an hour and is Wired's top upgrade pick for portable chargers.
Casetify's storewide sale does not apply to iPhone 15 products, and many OtterBox items are 20 percent off.
